title: Debugging & Operations
summary: A troubleshooting playbook for containers that exit, crash, get OOM-killed, can't be reached or won't build, plus the tools and day-2 operations around them: logs, inspect, events, stats, debug shells, logging drivers and rotation, disk cleanup and monitoring.
objectives: Read container exit codes (0, 1, 125, 126, 127, 137, 139, 143) and map each to likely causes
Diagnose containers that exit immediately, crash-loop, get OOMKilled or ignore SIGTERM
Debug minimal/distroless containers with `docker debug`, netshoot, or a busybox sidecar sharing PID and network namespaces
Fix 'exec format error' and other architecture mismatches on Apple Silicon
Configure logging drivers and log rotation, and reclaim disk space safely
Monitor resource usage with `docker stats`, `docker events`, ctop and lazydocker
